subject: Update complete
author: Xandu
body:
We have now completed the update of BurnoutAholics.com.

Here are some of the changes:

  • The news headlines sections has been removed and replaced by the new startpage.
  • Users can add comments to stories and news
  • New section for Community Videos
  • The worldmap is gone. Will be replaced at a later time
  • Forum added
  • User profiles added, currently disabled.
  • All new layout
